newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close down on futures expiry.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close down on futures expiry.

text.p: French shares closed with a sharp loss on Friday, hit by a further 55 point fall in the Dow Jones Industrial Index on Wall Street and profit-taking on the expiry of February futures, dealers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 21.85 points or 0.83 percent at 2,607.55 at while the CAC-40 March futures contract was down at 2,625 from 2,640 on Thursday's close.
Volume was 8.5 billion francs of which 6.4 billion on CAC-40 shares. GAN was suspended and Renault closed 13 percent higher at 146.90 francs after a Belgian plant closure announcement.
The publication of U.S. fourth quarter GDP data in the afternoon had little impact.

AGF closed four percent down at 200.50 francs as speculation about a bid for it faded and amid market talk it could itself be interested in the insurance business of GAN which will be bailed out by a 20 billion franc state package.

GAN was suspended at 149.10 francs, after a 21.22 percent rise. "Obviously the market's assumption is that the government is pretty much writing out a blank cheque and not diluting shareholders," one insurance analyst said.
